# GAPS — Growth Accelerator Program for SMEs

> A twelve-month executive programme for India's MSME owners, by application only, built and led by Rajiv K Chawla (https://rajivkchawla.com/). Not a course. Personalised expert support, structured training and considered inputs across the half of the business most owners run blind on.

## The programme

GAPS rests on three pillars: Personalised Support (a panel of expert counsels as one relationship), Structured Training (24 expert-led online sessions plus 6 in-person events — 30 touchpoints a year), and Astro-Numerology (a considered input alongside the numbers, never a replacement for them).

The six gaps it closes: government schemes and subsidies owners never claimed; company structure and governance; succession and family constitution; capital beyond the CC limit; legal, contracts and disputes; and peer learning with owners at the same scale.

The expert panel covers corporate governance, direct tax and financial health, GST and indirect tax, wealth management, central and state subsidy schemes, growth and go-to-market, and Supreme Court legal counsel.

Additional benefit: selected members are nominated for a fully sponsored 21-day manufacturing immersion in Germany, travel and stay covered.

## Pricing

GAPS Premium: ₹2,40,000 + GST for a full year. Includes the full expert panel as an extended team, direct access to Rajiv K Chawla, 24 expert-led online sessions, 6 in-person events, nomination for the Germany training, subsidy discovery and filing support, legal, tax, structuring and succession work, and an astro consultation and report.

### How to apply
1. A 15-minute call about your business
2. Mutual fit check on sector, stage and intent
3. Enrol and meet your team

Enrolment: https://rajivkchawla.exlyapp.com/checkout/f3f404f7-c6c2-45f9-b772-f2dae868e6c1
